# Tukuk-OS

> Tukuk-OS is a free, account-free, Malay-first internet portal served from
> https://tukuk.org: a privacy-first web search engine with AI answers, an
> in-browser game arcade, low-bandwidth chat (T Chat), and radio/music/news
> explorers. It is self-hosted
> (Meilisearch index), sets no tracking cookies, and exposes a friendly JSON
> API. Content and UI are primarily in Malay (Bahasa Melayu) and work on weak
> networks (2G). Search results pages (`/cari`) carry no ads; the homepage
> dashboard may.

Tukuk-OS answers a query by ranking its own crawled index, then can generate an
extractive or LLM-assisted answer. Beyond search it hosts an in-browser game
arcade (`/games`) and an app hub on the homepage, a live NASA data hub
(`/nasa`), and radio/music/news verticals.

## Core search & AI
- [Search](https://tukuk.org/search?q=sqlite): ranked results from the local index. `GET /search?q=<query>&limit=<n>`.
- [Ask (AI answer)](https://tukuk.org/ask?q=apa+itu+tukuk-os): extractive/cloud answer for a question. `GET /ask?q=<question>`.
- [Brain status](https://tukuk.org/brain): which AI backend is active (cloud/ollama/extractive) + online state.
- [API index](https://tukuk.org/api): self-describing list of available endpoints.
- [CC asset search](https://tukuk.org/cc?q=cat): Creative Commons images (Wikimedia Commons), returns `{title,thumb,full,license,author}`.

## Content
- [Blog](https://tukuk.org/blog): engineering & privacy articles (Malay). Individual posts at `/blog/<slug>`.
- [Docs](https://tukuk.org/docs): how the engine and tools work.
- [About](https://tukuk.org/about) · [Privacy](https://tukuk.org/privacy) · [Terms](https://tukuk.org/terms) · [Contact](https://tukuk.org/contact).
- [NASA hub](https://tukuk.org/nasa): APOD, ISS, Mars, asteroids, EPIC, space weather, crew (JSON under `/api/nasa/*`).
- [Radio](https://tukuk.org/radio) · [Music](https://tukuk.org/music) · [News](https://tukuk.org/news).

## Chat & apps
- [T Chat](https://tukuk.org/apps/chat): chat PWA engineered for 2G/GPRS — receipt reads, offline queue, minimal data.
- [Game arcade](https://tukuk.org/games): 3D browser games, play instantly with a global leaderboard.
- [App hub](https://tukuk.org/): mini apps and games on the homepage; each can be installed as a PWA or downloaded as a signed APK via `/api/apk/<id>`.

## Apps & tools
- [Today](https://tukuk.org/today): the daily briefing — live weather for eight world cities (Open-Meteo, keyless, one call) plus the ECB reference exchange rates with day-over-day change, on one screen, refreshed every 15 minutes. An RSS 2.0 companion at <https://tukuk.org/today.xml> publishes the same briefing as per-day feed items. No account, no key, no tracking.
- [App hub](https://tukuk.org/): mini apps and games on the homepage (install as PWA or fetch a signed APK).
- [Download](https://tukuk.org/download): T Chat for every OS.
- [Utilities](https://tukuk.org/alat): sixty-six browser-local tools — unit, date/age, percentage, loan & compound interest, base converter (2–36, BigInt-exact), text↔binary bytes, prime check & factorisation, fraction, GCD/LCM with Euclid steps, combinations & permutations (exact BigInt), triangle solver (SSS/SAS, law of cosines), statistics, salary, tip & bill split, discount stacking, countdown, weighted grade, HTML-entity encode/decode, JWT decoder, Roman numerals, number-to-words & cheque phrasing, duration converter, card/IBAN/ISBN check-digit validator, unit-price comparison, fuel economy, sleep-cycle planner, lorem ipsum, aspect ratio, CSS units, exact dice probability, download-time estimator, readability (Flesch) scoring, calorie/TDEE needs, inflation compounding, Caesar–Vigenère ciphers, paint coverage, recipe scaling with real fractions, print-size (px→in/cm at DPI), electricity cost, running pace & race splits, a layers-based design studio with PNG export (canvas, zero uploads), QR code, IP lookup, Unix time, randomness, PDF merge/split/rotate, JSON formatter, MD5–SHA-512 checksums, Base64, time-zone meeting planner, UUID generator/decoder, cron explainer, colour/contrast, password, text, BMI/calories, image compressor and dictionary. Nothing is uploaded; every answer is computed on the visitor's device.
- [Dictionary & Translator](https://tukuk.org/alat/dictionary) (the older `/alat/kamus` and `/kamus` both redirect here): define and translate across hundreds of human languages, plus animal, alien, sound and ancient-script encoders (runes, hieroglyphs, Morse, Braille), with browser read-aloud. `GET /api/kamus/define?word=&lang=` · `GET /api/kamus/translate?text=&from=&to=`.

## Maps & world data
- [Maps & Navigation](https://tukuk.org/maps): turn-by-turn route planner (OSRM + Nominatim, no API key) with four base views — open street map, high-resolution satellite (Esri World Imagery), a live daily true-color satellite composite and a daily night-lights band (NASA GIBS, renewed every 24 h).
- [Live Earth — Satellite View](https://tukuk.org/maps/sky): full-window satellite globe — today's NASA true-color pass, nightly city lights (VIIRS day/night band), Blue Marble and street-level high-res, with fly-to place search.
- [Distance Calculator](https://tukuk.org/maps/distance) · [Sunrise & Sunset](https://tukuk.org/maps/sun) · [World Clock](https://tukuk.org/maps/clock).
- [World Weather](https://tukuk.org/weather) · [World Earthquakes](https://tukuk.org/earthquakes) · [Traffic](https://tukuk.org/traffic).

## Machine-readable
- [sitemap.xml](https://tukuk.org/sitemap.xml): full URL list.
- [robots.txt](https://tukuk.org/robots.txt): crawl policy (Googlebot/Bingbot allowed).
- [health](https://tukuk.org/health): liveness check.
- [Onion mirror](http://d33axv7iaq4sp5hlwjn7i2tovkuxmxc53xl2drjhve7mboitsoicdfid.onion/): Tor copy of the site (advertised via the `Onion-Location` header).

## Notes for agents
- All endpoints return JSON unless the request `Accept`s `text/html` (content negotiation on `/search`, `/ask`, etc.).
- `/api/image?url=` is a same-origin image proxy for cross-origin media.
- No account or API key is required for search, ask, blog, NASA, radio, maps, kamus, or weather.
